method.primary_source_rule: A publisher passage or official scholarly record is required for an adopted proposition; search snippets are discovery only.
method.metadata_check: One current Crossref works lookup per frozen DOI; relation and update-to fields preserved as metadata observations.
method.correction_retraction_boundary: An empty Crossref relation/update-to field is not a definitive global retraction clearance. Sources without an accessible primary passage or sufficient current correction evidence remain unresolved.

records.limitation: Historical landscape claims about hierarchy, recovery, traceability, or success are not refreshed P1 evidence.

records.accepted_proposition: The authors report task-specific benefit from planner, per-species executor, and aggregation decomposition for selected thermochemistry benchmark tasks under their named models and three-run averaging.
records.limitation: Not independent replication, universal multi-agent benefit, physical-validity proof, or ChemSmart SOTA evidence.

records.accepted_proposition: The authors report translation of textual synthetic procedures into XDL with syntactic and hardware-constrained simulation checks; this is an adjacent-domain analogy for structured procedures plus deterministic validation.
records.limitation: Not a quantum-chemistry study or evidence that an LLM critic is a scientific authority; no unlocated numeric critic claim is accepted.

records.accepted_proposition: ChemCrow is a chemistry-agent architecture reference for expert-designed tool augmentation.
records.limitation: Does not establish provenance-complete computational chemistry, Runtime V2 correctness, reproducibility, or SOTA.
The historical modular-scheduling statement is not refreshed P1 evidence.
No P1 claim about immutable lineage or restartability is accepted from title-level evidence.

records.accepted_proposition: Workflow Run RO-Crate is a provenance-packaging design reference for recording workflow-execution provenance and associated objects at varying granularity.
records.limitation: A manifest format does not itself prove scientific validity, reproducibility, or agent performance.

supported: No present-tense ChemSmart performance or SOTA claim.
unresolved: Definitive global correction/retraction clearance for all records
rejected: Literature-only SOTA or ChemSmart scientific-readiness claim
